
 Usage: openajar status [OPTIONS] [name]

 Ask a node through its tunnel who it is and which lanes it has. On a node with
 no connections, this node itself.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   name      <str>  Connection name (default: every connection).              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --json           Print JSON.                                                 │
│ --check          Check this node (or this computer's connections) and say    │
│                  how to fix what is wrong.                                   │
│ --help           Show this message and exit.                                 │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
